unused_or_redundant.why: Precious metals spot already has a four-provider fallback chain (TradingView → gold-api.com → Swissquote → GoldAPI → yfinance). At 20 calls/month cap, GoldAPI is a weak last-but-one link. Given that Swissquote is keyless and available, GoldAPI adds little value and burns metered quota. Consider removing or merging with the Swissquote path.

recommendations.change: Simplify precious metals spot chain: remove GoldAPI as intermediate tier. Keep TradingView (batched) → gold-api.com (keyless) → Swissquote (keyless). Use GoldAPI only as a true final fallback if both free sources fail on the same day.
